slots.name: WAICO signatory countries
slots.sentence: Twenty-nine countries signed the agreement to establish the World AI Cooperation Organization.

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: China hosted the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference and the High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance in Shanghai from July 17 to July 20, held during the APEC digital weeks (China holds the 2026 APEC host year).

slots.name: guest count
slots.sentence: In the July 7 countdown briefing, officials announced the conference would include more than 1,400 guests, over 140 forums, and more than 300 product debuts.

slots.name: outcomes count
slots.sentence: The NDRC released two outcomes at the conference: a collection of AI application success cases covering more than 20 countries and an action plan for AI cooperation and development spanning eight areas including intelligent computing, open ecosystems, and security governance.
